activity_statements.statement: operates 60+ automated car wash locations across Indiana, Illinois, and Minnesota providing exterior tunnel washing, self-serve vacuum stations, and interior cleaning services to consumers
sells unlimited wash membership/subscription plans to regular customers enabling recurring revenue at its Midwest car wash locations
operates as a privately-held, family-owned business (Dahm family) founded in 1948, growing from Indiana's first automated carwash to one of the largest carwash chains in the nation
actively expanding into new Midwest markets including Wisconsin as of 2026, with new location openings and site development
